text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've been asked to help with a mini
concert the
academy is putting on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Four Umamusume will be performing.
The concert
won't be for a while, but the
promo posters have
already arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: One, two! One, two!
choice_data_list: Let's go put them up all over the ...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Oh! Hello again!
choice_data_list: Good work, you're really putting y...
Good work, you're really working hard.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thanks again for helping me tutor my
classmates.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Remembering back, she was practicing
her
dancing before her classmate called
us away. And
now that I think of it...
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah, that happened.
Ah, yeah, that happened.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That poster... Wow, they've arrived
already?
That's fast. But yeah, I am!
choice_data_list: I see, so you're running in this too!
I see, you're entering this too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't Opera O look fantastic on that
poster?
And so do Doto and Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me—I heard a trainer's
been
assigned to the event as support
staff.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence! Well, here's to
working
together again!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it ended up being me.
Yeah, it ended up being me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to believe she started
practicing for the
concert so far in advance. She's
the epitome of
dedicated.
choice_data_list: Right back at you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, while I'm checking the
trainer
version of the school's event
schedule...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Do you have a moment,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, were you checking the school
schedule?
Perfect timing, then. ♪
choice_data_list: Yes, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There have been some changes to the

participants listed for the next
scrimmage. Here's
the new list.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a look and notice Narita Top Road
has
been added to it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We were worried that we wouldn't
find a sub
in time, but she volunteered
to fill the vacant
slot.
choice_data_list: Is she running in it?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's got her whole class excited. She's
quite the
popular class rep, you know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's doing this on top of the upcoming
concert? I'm worried she might be
overstretching herself,
so I go to check
in the training center, and...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huff! Huff! Phew!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Oh? It's you.
choice_data_list: Working this late after all...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for coming to check on me! I
guess I
must've worried you...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
But if you're scared I'm overworking
myself, I'm
not. I'm keeping a close eye
on how much I'm
training just to be sure.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Can I show you my dance for
the
concert, please?
choice_data_list: Still...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I can answer, she starts dancing.

Compared to the last time I saw her...
choice_data_list: Wait...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Well? Does that ease your
worries a
little?
choice_data_list: So good...! It's already completel...
So good...! It's already perfect...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I started practicing my dance ages ago
and
polished it up little by little. I've
already nailed it
down completely.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've been devoting more time
to my
running than dancing lately!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's brushing it off like it's nothing,
but it's clear
how much effort she's putting in
daily to meet
everyone's expectations.
choice_data_list: You're incredible...!
You really are amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's brushing it off like it's nothing,
but it's clear
how much effort she's putting in
daily to meet
everyone's expectations.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to seeing you ...
Still, make sure not to overdo it,...
Still, make sure not to overdo it,...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I'll do even more training to
make sure I
don't let you down!
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to seeing you ...
Still, make sure not to overdo it,...
Still, make sure not to overdo it,...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She gives me one last bright smile
before
returning to the field.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, on the day of the scrimmage,
Narita Top
Road does spectacularly!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, I will. I was just thinking of
calling it a day
soon.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I have an idea! Why don't you join me
for some
cool-down stretches? You must
be feeling stiff
from all your desk work!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, on the day of the scrimmage,
Narita Top
Road does spectacularly!
